description: Generate an image from a text prompt, or edit / combine input images. Returns the URL(s) of the generated image(s), valid 30 days, plus a downscaled preview when the client can show tool-result images to you. Images take about 50 s (9 in 10 within 90 s); if the task is still running when wait_seconds is up you get a task id — call get_task with it, do not resubmit. If you cannot see the image in the result, call review_image with the returned URL to get a written critique and a revised prompt, then generate again. Roughly $0.025 per image on the default model; gpt-image-2-lite is $0.01. gpt-image-2.6-flare / gpt-image-2.6-sunburst can also return an animated GIF (output_format "gif", 2–16 frames) or an SVG vector (output_format "svg", text-to-image only, $0.0315); a GIF on a solid green screen comes back with the green keyed out to transparent (pass background "opaque" to keep it).

background.description: "transparent": a transparent background (gpt-image family), or with doubao-seedream-5-0-flash / -pro keep the transparency of ONE input PNG passed as image_url. "opaque": force an opaque background — on gpt-image-2.6 GIFs this also stops the automatic green-screen keying.

extra.description: Optional model-specific parameters passed through as-is, e.g. {"seed": 42} or {"scale": 4, "face_enhance": true} for real-esrgan. See the model page on apimodels.app/docs. Keys set by the fields above are ignored here.

image_url.description: Optional input image for edits. Accepts a public https:// URL, a LOCAL FILE PATH, a localhost URL, a data: URI or an asset:// reference — local sources are uploaded for you automatically.

image_urls.description: Several input / reference images (up to 16 on gpt-image-2.6, fewer on most models — e.g. 3 on flux-2-klein-4b). Same accepted forms as image_url. Use this to combine subjects or keep a character consistent across images.

layer_decomposition.description: Split the image in image_url into a flattened base plus up to 16 transparent PNG layers (text blocks, subjects, props), each returned with a name and its box in the original. prompt is optional. Billed $0.03 per output image, so tell the user the cost depends on how many layers come back (at most $0.51). doubao-seedream-5-0-flash only.

markup_image_url.description: Optional markup image for gpt-image-2.6 edits: a transparent PNG with only circles, arrows or notes drawn on it, the same size as the first input image; the model edits the first input accordingly.

mask_url.description: Optional edit mask: white = change, black = keep, same size as the first input image (gpt-image family). Not with gif output, and not together with markup_image_url.

model.description: Image model id, e.g. gpt-image-2, gpt-image-2.6-flare (GIF / SVG output, markup-image edits, up to 16 references), gpt-image-2.6-sunburst (highest fidelity), gpt-image-2.5-flare, flux-2-klein-4b ($0.006, fastest, up to 3 reference images), gpt-image-2-lite, gemini-3-pro-image, gemini-3-pro-image-gemini ($0.03 flat), qwen3-image (small in-image text), gemini-3.1-flash-image, nano-banana-2-1 (Google Nano Banana 2.1: $0.022 1K / $0.036 2K / $0.06 4K, accurate in-image text, 15 aspect ratios incl. 21:9 and 1:8), doubao-seedream-5-0-flash ($0.03, fast, 1K/2K; supports background and layer_decomposition), doubao-seedream-5-0-pro ($0.03 1K / $0.06 2K, precise region edits). Call list_models for the full list.

n.description: Optional number of images to generate in one call (models that support it; billed per image).

output_format.description: Optional output format. gif = animated GIF and svg = vector, both on gpt-image-2.6 only. If omitted, opaque images are delivered as JPEG.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate (or the edit to make). Required, except with layer_decomposition where it is optional.

quality.description: Optional quality tier, e.g. low / medium / high (gpt-image family, Grok Imagine). Higher costs more.

reasoning_effort.description: gpt-image-2.6 only: how much the model plans before drawing.

return_image.description: Attach a downscaled preview (max 1024px JPEG) of the result so you can look at it. Set false to save context when you only need the URL.

size.description: Optional exact pixel size "WIDTHxHEIGHT", e.g. 1024x1024 or 1536x1024 (models that take exact sizes, such as the gpt-image family). For a GIF this is the size of each frame.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the image before returning a task id instead (seconds, 0–900). Default 50: Codex aborts tool calls at 60 s unless tool_timeout_sec is raised. In Claude Code / Claude Desktop you can pass up to 900 to get the URL in one call.

name: generate_image
